title: Buffers
description: A weak acid and its salt together hold a pH steady, because added acid or base only shifts their ratio. Unlocks the Buffer Tank.

puzzle.goal: A weak acid of pKa p is mixed with its salt, a parts of salt to h parts of acid. Write the pH y it holds, using natural logs.
puzzle.name: Henderson-Hasselbalch
puzzle.ask: Find the pH for p = @{p}, a = @{a} and h = 1.
puzzle.method: Ka = [H⁺][A⁻]/[HA]; take −log₁₀ of both sides and rearrange.
